page.overview:
Who is KaibaCorp special forces?

The Kaiba Corporation special forces (コーポレーション tokushu butai) are a tactical unit of KaibaCorp, appearing in Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions.

The special forces aided in Seto Kaiba's abduction of Diva, following his theft of two Millennium Puzzle pieces. While Diva was an a rooftop, they flew helicopters nearby. Some of the forces dropped out of the helicopters and subdued Diva. They blindfolded him with a deprivation mask to block his communication with the Prana and took the Quantum Cube. They then flew him away for interrogation.
